scores.tell: Cobblestone floor has many small stones and a glowing fire with sticks under the pot; the pink stripe wall is fine, but the extra story prop and busy floor are more than real cards use.
Fully rendered park with path, two big trees, bushes, many flowers and grass tufts. Too many small details for a central object. Real category-4 cards use a few big quiet shapes.
Desert scene with rail ties, cacti, rocks, mesas, clouds and a bell and coal. Busy and wide, and the track runs through the whole card. Real cards are quieter.
Same park as c106, with flowers, tufts, path stones and a tree canopy all over. Slightly more detail than the real swing card.
none. Concentric rings on a flat field, as in the real glove and cart cards. Quiet and floating.
none. The pi pattern is tone-on-tone and quiet, like the real whistle card.
Sky and clouds with a hill are fine, but the tower is the whole card. Clouds are many and large, and the grass tufts are small, so it reads a bit busy.
Soft stripe backdrop, nothing else. Close to the real cards. The stripes are a bit wide and contrasty.
Same quiet stripe backdrop as c131, with no props. Nothing stands out.
Wood table plus stripe wall with a sharp tabletop edge. Plank grain is rendered in detail, so the setting is heavier than the real cards' plain ledges. A close copy of the grade 1 lesson's staging.
